shortBio.en: Early Metallica guitarist, then Megadeth founder; 1983 firing as lifelong interview hook.
shortBio.zh: 早期 Metallica 吉他手，后建 Megadeth；1983 被开除成终身采访钩子。

whyHub.en: Metallica → Megadeth personnel bridge; thrash map and site trope in one person.
whyHub.zh: Metallica → Megadeth 人事桥；thrash 地图与本站梗集于一人。

body.en:
Fired from Metallica 1983; builds Megadeth the same year. Rhythm riff author and sneering vocal across decades of lineup churn.

Related people/bands: thrash Big Four rivalry as career structure.
body.zh:
1983 被 Metallica 开除；同年组建 Megadeth。跨几十年阵容更替的节奏 riff 作者与冷笑人声。

相关：把 thrash Big Four 对打当职业结构。
